feature_title: Top Customers by Spend analytics endpoint
user_requirement: As a store manager I want to see the top customers ranked by total spend so I can prioritise loyalty outreach.
user_goal_or_pain: Managers currently export orders to a spreadsheet and pivot by customer manually before each monthly review.
desired_outcome: A dashboard endpoint returns the top N customers by total spend, ready for the analytics screen to render.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/dashboard/top-customers returns customers ordered by total spend (desc) with a configurable limit.
Spend totals are computed from real order data and expressed in integer satang (no floats).
Existing dashboard and order APIs still pass their tests (no regression).
current_behavior: Order data is visible per-order but there is no aggregated top-customers view.

existing_system_context.notes: Follow the existing dashboard/revenue vertical slice as the pattern.

software_engineer_requirements: DB access stays in a repository; business logic in a service; controller stays thin.
Register exactly one new route; do not alter existing route contracts.

constraints.security: aggregated spend is business-sensitive; endpoint must respect existing auth
constraints.performance: aggregation should be a single indexed query, not per-customer N+1

non_goals: No new frontend screen in this iteration (endpoint only).

evaluation_method.description: service ranks customers by spend correctly, incl. empty data
manager confirms the ranking matches expectations

human_decision_points: Approve whether to add a new endpoint or extend the existing revenue endpoint.
